purpose: Combine first PG17 atomic publication, exact source/inserted byte equality, received row count and existing-format fingerprint in one DML CTE; keep logged storage, locks, fences, constraints and legacy retry fingerprint
retention: Correctness and upgrade/crash checks pass; every scenario median throughput gain >=5%, every pair nonnegative; otherwise revert prototype. Original per-pair +25% and +50% gates are assessed separately and remain required for goal completion.
correctness: native SQL count and fingerprint equivalence, exact value comparisons
logged process crash recovery before/during/after publication
previous publisher -> new publisher and reverse same-ID compatibility
isolation: No concurrent local builds, DB tests, compression or Engine jobs during timed performance; retain unrelated project containers
storage: Reuse existing one-million-row source and sequential resets; existing 6GiB guard and per-backend temp limit; no durability reduction
scope: Same atomic semantics vs previous fork; not untreated upstream, all writers or billion-row guarantee
